items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Well they had a piano player there, and Verney Johnson was playing in front of them, boy.

ctx.x: Now what kind of band was that that you were there, with McCarthy and Jeff?

Well they had a piano player there, and Verney Johnson was playing in front of them, boy. And they just added me to what they had there with my little group. That's why the guy picked me up for the game. And they used to add to some of the musicians that had quit him. And the trumpet player that was there before was a fellow named Frenchy. Oh yeah, Paul D. Christian.
Paul D. Christian, right. But that band, what was the name of that band?
